reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

# Construct transformed test output from 5x5 framed tiles.
H=W=22
out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
def tile(frame, inner):
    return [[frame]*5 if r in (0,4) else [frame]+[inner]*3+[frame] for r in range(5)]
def put(r,c,frame,inner):
    t=tile(frame,inner)
    for i in range(5):
        for j in range(5):
            assert out[r+i][c+j]==0, (r+i,c+j,out[r+i][c+j],frame,inner)
            out[r+i][c+j]=t[i][j]
# outer 2 tiles slide right, packed against each other where vertical spans overlap
put(1,17,2,1)
put(4,12,2,7)
put(8,17,2,3)
put(10,12,2,6)
put(15,17,2,4)
# outer 8 tiles slide left, with same-color overlap packed in original order
put(2,0,8,1)
put(16,0,8,9)
put(14,5,8,6)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
